nodes.question: How does the proposed model merging method improve performance while addressing computational costs?
nodes.answer: The proposed method allows for the integration of different models, boosting performance (up to 6.8% in mIoU) while increasing speed by 3.25 times, all without incurring additional computational costs associated with traditional model ensembling strategies.
nodes.paragraph: Our main contributions can be summarized as follows: (1) Cost-free model merging by introducing a novel method to merge existing available pretrained models with-out requiring additional training costs. (2) Cross-task model merging by applying model merging to combine models designed for different tasks with sharedparameters. (3) Extensive benchmarking of model merging for unsu- pervised domain adaptation, focusing on multiple models, strategies and datasets. The remainder of the paper is organized as follows: Sect. 2 reviews related work on semantic segmentation, unsuper- vised domain adaptation and model merging. In Sect. 3, details the core hypothesis of this work: initial layers should be merged differently from nal layers.
